newsitem.title: USA: Komag sees first half 1997 constrained.
newsitem.headline: Komag sees first half 1997 constrained.

text.p: Komag Inc said while it expects to show continued progress on yields, the rate at which its improves yields on new products will likely continue to constrain financial results in the first half of 1997.

The company said it expects to show sequential improvement in gross margins in the first two quarters of 1997 and is currently targeting a gross margin range of 30 percent to 35 percent for the second half of the year.

Komag said it will invest about $290 million in 1997 for facilities and related expenses. Research and development expenditures for 1997 are planned at about $50 million, a 70 percent increase over 1996, Komag said.
